senses.definition: Without stopping; without a break, cessation, or interruption.

quotes.text: he can hear its continuous murmur

quotes.text: […] the Plan incorporates in proper combination every available modern technique, including extensive electrification on the new standard high-voltage a.c. system at a frequency of 50 cycles; main-line diesel traction as a half-way house to electrification; lightweight diesel trains for secondary and branch services; and a smaller wagon fleet doing more work by the use of continuous brakes in conjunction with modernised terminals and marshalling yards.

senses.definition: (botany) Not deviating or varying from uniformity; not interrupted; not joined or articulated.
(mathematical analysis, of a function) Such that, for every x in the domain, for each small open interval D about f(x), there's an interval containing x whose image is in D.
(mathematics, more generally, of a function between two topological spaces) Such that each open set in the target space has an open preimage (in the domain space, with respect to the given function).
examples: Each continuous function from the real line to the rationals is constant, since the rationals are totally disconnected.

senses.definition: (grammar) Expressing an ongoing action or state.
